name: Baber Arjumand
headline: Software Engineer | Frontend Lead | Full-Stack
availability: Remote worldwide · Delivered for teams in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf

summary.label: Summary
summary.text: Software engineer and technical leader with over 6 years building production web and mobile products across the full stack.

highlights.label: Summary
items: Software engineer with over 6 years building production web and mobile products, including more than 4 years in Front End Lead and CTO roles for teams in 6 countries.
Shipped a B2B cross-border payment platform, a Web3 cross-chain asset network, and an AI messaging platform serving 3 channels, each taken from prototype to release.
Owns the full delivery path: system design, REST and Go APIs, CI/CD, automated testing, and iOS and Android app-store release.

items.companyNote: Online marketplace for private Quran tutoring.
bullets: Own product and engineering for a marketplace matching students with private Quran teachers across booking, scheduling, and onboarding.
Direct growth operations for a remote-first tutoring network, including teacher vetting and search visibility.

items.companyNote: Cross-border payments startup serving multinational corporates.
bullets: Architected a B2B cross-border payment platform from concept to alpha in 8 months using React and Tailwind CSS.
Engineered Node.js, Express, and MongoDB services with Python microservices for financial reporting.
Integrated Mastercard Digital Asset Solutions and shipped a real-time multi-branch liquidity dashboard.
Established CI/CD on Firebase Hosting and Heroku for continuous frontend and backend delivery.

items.companyNote: AI conversational commerce platform for enterprise messaging.
bullets: Shipped AI conversational commerce features in React across 3 channels: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Discord.
Built Go and PostgreSQL services on AWS for high-concurrency messaging workflows.
Migrated the unified customer inbox from Redux to Jotai, cutting state-management surface area.
Built engagement analytics dashboards and instrumented the platform with Datadog.

items.companyNote: Web3 social network for cross-chain digital assets.
bullets: Directed frontend architecture for a Web3 social platform verifying cross-chain assets and NFTs.
Migrated a legacy Angular codebase to React and Next.js, improving load performance, SEO, and scalability.
Engineered multi-wallet authentication ahead of WalletConnect across multiple blockchain protocols.
Led a distributed frontend team and set coding standards, performance benchmarks, and automated testing.
Directed 4 technical functions — web engineering, UI/UX, IT infrastructure, and digital marketing — for a concurrent client portfolio.
Supervised offshore engineering and creative teams delivering healthcare, food service, and non-profit accounts.
Recruited and hired full-stack developers, SEO analysts, and content strategists while owning budgets, timelines, and QA.

items.companyNote: Software product studio building mobile and web applications.
bullets: Set technical strategy and translated business requirements into specifications and Agile sprint plans.
Governed the delivery lifecycle across teams through code review, testing standards, and deployment gates.

items.role: Full Stack Engineer, then Frontend Developer

Integrated Stripe, Apple, and Google payments and configured CI/CD on AWS, Heroku, and Firebase.
